title: Profile & Preferences
subtitle: Set how your profile looks and how games are recommended to you.
showLeaderboardHint: Only your display name and XP are visible.
prefsIntro: These choices are only used to order recommendations and tune comfort — they never affect odds or game results.
animationHint: Choose Reduced or Off if animation feels distracting.
personalizationHint: When off, game order is neutral and optional behavioural history is deleted.
noManipulation: We never change odds, payouts or the game experience based on your individual behaviour.
resetRecText: Favourite categories, liked styles, difficulty and optional behavioural history will be cleared.
deleteEventsText: All optional behaviour records (e.g. games viewed) will be permanently deleted. Round and wallet history are unaffected.
